params.body:
## Why

Until #932 the vehicle form wrote eighteen damage rows with `note = ''` for every new car, and `has_damage` counted any row whose note was not NULL. Those cars went to Nederland Mobiel with `<accident>1</accident>`. Since #932 they read as damage-free here, but the advert keeps the accident flag until the car is sent again, and a car nobody edits is never sent again.

## What

`php artisan stocklist:resend-cleared-damage` (rule R P3-5.17).

- **Selection, through the models:** not deleted, complete, not sold (`sold` and `sold_at`), at least one damage row the old rule counted (note or path NOT NULL) and no row that counts now (`Damage::scopeWithContent`). A real note, a photo or an own photo path is never selected. Options: `--since=` (vehicle `created_at`), `--vehicle=*`, `--dealer=*`.
- **Per channel, Nederland Mobiel only:** flagged `is_on_nederland_mobiel`, dealer has the link (the same two conditions `ListOnNederlandMobiel::whyNot` asks), and the last feed stored on the car (`nederland_mobiel_xml`) did not already say `<accident></accident>`. No stored feed means the car is sent.
- **Guard:** for every car that would go, the feed is built the way the send builds it (`XML::getXML`) and `<accident>` is read back. If one still says `1`, the command stops and sends nothing.
- **Dry run by default:** one line per car (last feed, what it would say now, send or skip with the reason), then counts and ids per outcome.
- **`--apply`:** asks the seal (`Outbound::impact('nederlandmobiel')`), then sends each car through `OwnStockService::sendToNederlandMobiel`, one at a time, `--pause=` ms between calls (default 300), at most `--limit=` cars. One line per car (sent with the advert url, or refused with the stored reason), a summary, exit 1 when any was refused.
- **Nothing on the car is saved.** `sendToNederlandMobiel` writes only its bookkeeping straight to the row (R P3-5.15), so `VehicleObserver` does not wake, `updated_at` and the damage rows stay, and bids on a bidding car stay (R B1-3.3). A refusal turns the flag off with the reason, as any refused send does (R P3-5.11).
- **Idempotent:** a second run sends nothing for a car already sent, because its stored feed then says no accident.

## The partner API is not resent

`vehicleResource` computed `has_damage` as `filled($d->note) || filled($d->path)` from the initial import until #932 (checked in every version of the file). `filled('')` is false, so the partner API has said `"has_damage": "false"` for these cars all along. A webhook would only make the partners fetch an identical sheet. The dry run says this in one line.

## Docs

- `docs/bedrijfsregels/33-p3-integraties.md`: new rule R P3-5.17.
- Finding `2026-10-02-een-lege-schadeplaats-telde-als-schade.md`: a paragraph on what already left and how to resend it.

## Tests

`tests/Feature/ResendClearedDamageTest.php` (`@rule P3-5.17`): selection (empty and white-space rows selected; real note, photo-only, own path, sold, `sold_at`, incomplete, deleted, NULL rows and no rows not selected), dry run per car with skips and nothing sent, `--since`/`--limit`/`--vehicle`, `--apply` sends each car once through the real feed with `<accident></accident>` and a second run sends nothing, a refusal is printed with its reason and exits 1, a sealed environment sends nothing, the guard stops on a feed that still says accident, and no model event fires on the vehicle (bid, `updated_at` and the empty rows unchanged). Dropping the "no row that counts" condition or the stored-feed skip turns them red. Full suite green locally (2872 tests), PHPStan clean, pint on the new files.

## After the merge, on production

```
cd /home/forge/traders.stocklistdealer.eu/current
php artisan stocklist:resend-cleared-damage
php artisan stocklist:resend-cleared-damage --apply --limit=10
php artisan stocklist:resend-cleared-damage --apply
php artisan stocklist:resend-cleared-damage
```

The last dry run should list nothing to send.
params.title: Resend to Nederland Mobiel the cars whose only damage rows were empty
